# Unexus AI

> AI-first digital marketing agency based in Dubai, UAE — GEO, SEO, paid media, website development, AI automation, and AI training for businesses across the UAE, India, and the wider Middle East. Founded by Richa Gupta; parent company SE Digicon has operated in India since 2015.

Every link below is a Markdown copy of the page (same URL + `.md`). The homepage is at https://www.unexusai.com/index.html.md.

## Services

- [All services](https://www.unexusai.com/services.md): Overview of the eight services and how they connect.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.unexusai.com/services/digital-marketing.md): SEO, GEO, paid media, email, and conversion tracking run as one connected system, measured on revenue.
- [SEO — Search Engine Optimisation](https://www.unexusai.com/services/seo.md): Technical SEO, local SEO, keyword and content strategy, and link building that grows rankings and revenue.
- [SEM — Search Engine Marketing](https://www.unexusai.com/services/sem.md): Google Ads and paid search that turn clicks into tracked, profitable leads.
- [GEO — Generative Engine Optimisation](https://www.unexusai.com/services/geo.md): Getting a business recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude — not just found on Google.
- [Website Development](https://www.unexusai.com/services/website-development.md): Fast, conversion-focused websites built in Next.js.
- [AI Automation](https://www.unexusai.com/services/ai-automation.md): AI agents, WhatsApp automation, RAG pipelines, and voice systems.
- [AI Training](https://www.unexusai.com/services/ai-training.md): Hands-on AI training built around a team's real workflows.
- [Market Research](https://www.unexusai.com/services/market-research.md): Audience research, competitor analysis, positioning, and market-entry research for the UAE and India.
